test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the price of a grocery item consumed by a family increases by 25%, then by what percentage should its consumption reduce, so as to keep the expenditure on this item unchanged?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the original price of grocery be Rs. 100

Then,

Increased price = Rs. 25

Reduction in consumption = [(25/125) × 100]%

⇒ 20%

**∴ The family will have to reduce the consumption of grocery by 20%**
